132-1379-3941-4687.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-1379-3941-4687.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.

1479-2841-7892-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-2841-7892-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil the Strategist and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1011-2728-5686-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-5686-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-5686-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1479-3478-7893.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2292-7084-7893.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4067-5003-6798-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
4067-5003-6798-7848.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent
Repeat steps 4 and 5 until you have {4} or more available.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
4067-5003-6798-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card. If the permanent taps for more than {1}, there can be less graveyards with seven cards in them.

2034-6006-6968-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1409-3099-4289-7060.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-1526-4359.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-4359.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1368-4359-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4359-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

4499-5434-6723-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1542-2450-4050-7639.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1542-2450-4050-7639.description:
Declare Wizards of Thay as an attacker. Its myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of it attacking each other opponent.
Holding priority, cast Whim of Volrath by paying {U} due to Wizards of Thay.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2

2440-4055-7546.description:
Cast Maestro's Gift from exile by paying {U}{R}, creating a token copy of Inspired Skypainter with haste that enters prepared.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Lizard or Wizard creature you control.
If needed, activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {U/R}.
If needed, repeat step 3 an additional time.
Repeat.
2440-4055-7546.notes: Mana needed drops significantly for each additional creature you control that is a Lizard or Wizard.

4186-4268-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-4268-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

240-2079-3967-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

147-2596-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2596-5147.description:
Cast Living Death by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Living Death.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Living Death
Resolve the Living Death copy, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, and returning all cards exiled this way to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

690-5306-6649.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
690-5306-6649.description:
Activate Disciple of Griselbrand by paying {1} and sacrificing Aettir and Priwen, causing you to gain life equal to Aettir and Priwen's toughness.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing target opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

4375-4779-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

3007-4222-6788.easyPrerequisites:
You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
3007-4222-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3007-4222-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

851-1563-2457-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2060-2511-3054-6701.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
2060-2511-3054-6701.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2060-2511-3054-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

4613-4968-6661.description:
Activate Minwu by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Minwu triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

560-2292-3394-4550.notablePrerequisites:
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2292-3394-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Weatherlight Compleated triggers twice, putting two phyresis counters on it and causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Repeat.

413-618-3991.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher token's trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token.
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
When Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat.

251-2034--6.notablePrerequisites: Denry has a -1/-1 counter on them.
251-2034--6.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Undying creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, its Undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Denry triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove the -1/-1 and the +1/+1 counter from the Undying creature as a state-based action.
Repeat.
Note that this combo has additional results depending on the Undying creature.

1624-1927-3625-3646.manaNeeded: {4}{G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1624-1927-3625-3646.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Redemption does not have summoning sickness.
1624-1927-3625-3646.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Storvald either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Storvald enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing Tree or Redemption's power and toughness to become 1 until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Redemption by tapping it, causing your life total to become 1.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

851-1645-1765-5231.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting any creature you control.
When Crown of Flames enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing the Spirits, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1349-4153-5256.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional nontoken creatures, one of which has a coin counter on it.
1349-4153-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Athreos trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter on another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature that died in step 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1331-1495-2445.notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1331-1495-2445.description:
If Triskelion has more than 3 +1/+1 counters on it, activate Trislekion by removing all additional counters to deal damage to your choice of targets.
Activate Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it to deal 1 damage to itself.
Repeat step 1 an additional 2 times, killing Triskelion.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Triskelion to the battlefield with Scythe of the Wretched attached to it.
Repeat.

4772-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trillobite has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
4772-4929-5189.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Cryptic Trilobite, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Saproling, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may alter this loop to produce infinite creature tokens, put infinite +1/+1 counters on all your creatures, and activate Cryptic Trilobite infinite times.
